content: YAML config loading in Go uses gopkg.in/yaml.v3 with yaml.Unmarshal(data, &config). TOML uses github.com/BurntSushi/toml with toml.DecodeFile(path, &config). Pattern: read file with os.ReadFile, unmarshal into struct, validate immediately. For layered config: define defaults, overlay file, then env vars. Viper supports both formats but adds dependencies.
